warnings: 9 pile caps, one per column point. Tags read 'F1, C2' at A1, B5, C1, D2, D5 and 'F2, C2' at A3, C3, C5, D4 — every tag sits directly above its cap. F1 = single-pile cap 0.36 x 0.36, F2 = two-pile cap 0.90 x 0.36 (detail S-03); every F2 is drawn with its 0.90 side along x.
The plan is L-shaped plus an offset: no footing at A2, B1-B4, C2, C4 or D1 (row B has a column only at B5; the lower wing starts at grid 2).

C2 (printed with every footing) is the column stub from the cap to the ground beams (C2 = 0.20 x 0.20, 6-DB12 on S-04) — recorded here once (9 points); the floor-level column C1 is recorded in the structure-plan file (view2).
